definition.text: Heb. harash (Ex. 35:35; 38:23) means properly an artificer in wood, stone, or metal. The chief business of the engraver was cutting names or devices on rings and seals and signets (Ex. 28:11, 21, 36; Gen. 38:18).

works.title: Ante-Nicene Fathers, Volume 2: Fathers of the Second Century
